request.prompt: required by stability-ai conservative/creative, optional for SYNTX (default "upscale"), refused elsewhere
request.response_format: url (default; data: URL for byte results, vendor URL for SYNTX) | b64_json

dispositions.reason: consumer firefly-3p upsample needs a firefly.adobe.com session cookie / ARP; DurinDoor keeps adobe-firefly / firefly unregistered and accepts no consumer cookie or web token (docs/providers/adobe-firefly.md); the guard is not bypassed

dispositions.answer: 501 with `unavailable: true`, before any credential read or network call
dispositions.reason: the pinned Firefly Services contract used by open-sse/providers/registry/adobe-firefly-api.js documents no upscale operation equivalent to the source's Topaz upsample job; a Services credential is never presented as a consumer session

safety.sourceImages: data: URI / bare base64 (Topaz, Stability) or data: URI (SYNTX) sniffed as PNG/JPEG/WebP, declared MIME must agree, <= 20 MiB (SYNTX 50 MiB); remote http(s) sources (Topaz, Stability) fetched via fetchPublic (<= 3 redirects, each hop re-validated) over guardedProbeFetch public-only (connection-time DNS pinned), no credential/cookie/vendor header, 30 s, caller signal; SYNTX remote sources must be https on a public literal host and are passed to SYNTX, never fetched by the gateway
safety.vendorCalls: fixed origins only, redirect manual and refused, foreign-origin answers refused, bounded deadlines, caller signal honored, bounded body reads, upstream bodies never quoted, credentials redacted from messages
safety.outputFidelity: Topaz/Stability bytes must sniff as the requested output_format and are returned as-is; SYNTX url results are returned unchanged after an https/public check, b64_json results must sniff as an image
safety.noSilentDropping: unknown fields, unsupported factors, conflicting aliases, size with factor, oversize outputs, prompts or creativity a model does not take, unknown output/response formats, n != 1 and streaming are refused with 400

accounting.success: mediaAccounting(null, provider, "image") with nativeUnits.images = returned images; cost unknown (no vendor receipt); meta { model, route, jobId | chatUuid }
accounting.acceptedJob: submit-unknown: timeout, abort or disconnect after a billable send, 5xx, redirect, foreign origin; accepted: any failure after a 2xx billable submit (unreadable or wrong-format result, Stability job poll failure/timeout, SYNTX poll/download failure); filtered: Stability CONTENT_FILTERED. Never resent or replayed.
accounting.quota: 402 -> quotaExhausted on this connection; 429 -> rate limit with Retry-After
